versions.content: WriteMemoryByAddress Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the configuration of UDS service 0x3D (WriteMemoryByAddress). Rationale: The service can be used to write a piece of data to the server's memory. Use Case: The user wants to overwrite the values in a given piece of server memory. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: More information about this diagnostic service can be found in the respective ISO specification [2].
